status: preregistered before any new model scores
primary_protocol: validation_v2 outer seed42, five StratifiedKFold folds; canonical sorted application IDs
feature_pool: Main232 with fit-customer expanding-month price reference plus verified teammate per-customer pre-reference numeric features. No teammate V3/V4/V5 population references. Actual width recorded by builder, not assumed880.
reference_and_selection: For inner experiments use48000 inner-fit IDs; for outer inference use56000 outer-train IDs. Selectors use only fitting labels. No outer labels in context, preprocessing, selector, or recipe choice.
model: NVIDIA Kumo-Tabular large, pinned local v1.0.1 checkpoint
categorical_preprocessing: Four application categories passed natively to SDM; vocabulary fitted only on actual labelled context, unknown query categories become missing. All other pool predictors numeric. Same rule for baseline and all members; internal numeric transformations fitted by the cached recipe.

candidate_views.name: nested_small
candidate_views.columns: 100 numeric selected by existing KS/Spearman selector on fitting partition plus4 application categories

members: three views x two independent model seeds, sequential fits
context_qualification: Wide views explicitly use stratified8192 context for8GB feasibility. Compact view retains all fitting rows. This is a resource-constrained candidate, not a claim of reproducing any external recipe with full context on every view.
aggregation: Within each outer validation cohort and corresponding test cohort, rank each member with average ties divided by cohort size, equal mean over six members. Assign fold OOF once; equal mean of five corresponding test-fold ensemble scores. Baseline ranked by same cohort convention. No weights optimized using outer OOF.

engineering.preflight: real fitting context and exact columns, small query, no KS or recipe selection. Any failure retained as engineering evidence; no automatic retry.

quality_policy: No score claim until measured. Screening is inner only. Full gate is all70000 aligned OOF with pooled KS>=0.53000 and clean audit; report fold KS,mean,AUC,paired delta and bootstrap uncertainty. If engineering rejects a view, this exact candidate is unavailable and a separately preregistered alternative is required, not a silent member substitution.
legacy_artifacts: Historical v56 and legacy main predictions are diagnostic only, not eligible strict baseline/candidate components.
submission: CSV only, after complete eligible evaluation; no Kaggle kernels or git push. No public forecast or0.003 gain requirement.
